_comment: Example Apache Tika 4.x configuration with Tesseract OCR enabled.
The SATVIQ Tika extractor normally GENERATES this configuration
Use this file only if you want to manage the Tika config yourself:
point tika_config_path / TIKA_CONFIG_PATH at it, or use it as the
tika-config.json of a Tika Server installation (same format).
IMPORTANT: tesseractPath is the DIRECTORY containing the
Tesseract executable, not the executable itself. On Windows with
the value is C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR as below.
The text-recognizers key is REQUIRED for OCR of standalone
images (PNG/JPG); without it the engine is registered but never
The empty default-parser entry is REQUIRED as well: a parsers
section listing only pdf-parser silently breaks image OCR.
When tesseractPath is set, Tesseract looks for language data in
the standard Windows installer layout already satisfies this.
